verdict.rationale: JumpCloud is a SaaS IT/identity platform, so in-product AI insights are a fair question to ask. The evidence documents no AI-generated insights or suggestions. Directory Insights aggregates and standardizes event logs into 'actionable data', but nothing says that output is AI-generated, so it is an adjacent analytics feature that earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
